intent: Cluster-level tpunit fixture verifying zstd journal compression: entries are uncompressed with no dictionary configured, compressed and smaller once one is, and decompress correctly on both compressed and uncompressed nodes, including after a full-cluster restart with compression enabled.

objects.name: CompressionTest
objects.role: tpunit::TestFixture exercising journal compression across three staged tests sharing one cluster

misfits.why: hardcodes two relative filesystem paths to locate the dictionary fixture depending on working directory, rather than using a shared test-fixture-path helper

name_fit.note: matches the compression feature under test

naming_quality.note: consistent, descriptive helper names (readRawJournalEntrySize vs. readDecompressedJournalEntry)
